questions.stem: It ____ Tom that broke the window yesterday.
questions.why: yesterday(어제)의 과거 일을 강조하므로 It was ~ that을 쓴다. It은 항상 단수이므로 were는 불가.

questions.stem: It ____ my sister that made this cake last night.
questions.why: last night(어젯밤) 과거의 일이므로 It was ~ that. It 뒤에는 단수 be동사만 온다.

questions.stem: It ____ Jim that helps me with math every day.
questions.why: every day(매일)의 현재 습관을 강조하므로 It is ~ that이 알맞다.

questions.stem: It ____ this book that I want to read.
questions.why: 현재 원하는 것(want)을 강조하므로 It is ~ that. 강조구문의 be동사는 that절의 시제와 맞춘다.

questions.stem: It was Mina ____ won the first prize.
questions.why: It ~ that 강조구문은 that을 쓴다. 사람을 강조할 때 who도 가능하지만 what·which·whom·whose는 쓸 수 없다.

questions.stem: It was this bag ____ I bought at the mall.
questions.why: 강조구문의 빈칸에는 that이 온다. 사물이므로 who·whom은 불가, what은 강조구문에 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: It was in the library ____ I met Jane.
questions.why: 장소 부사구 in the library를 강조하는 It ~ that 강조구문이다. 부사구 뒤에는 that만 가능하다.

questions.stem: It was yesterday ____ we watched the movie.
questions.why: 시간 부사 yesterday를 강조하는 강조구문이므로 that을 쓴다.

questions.stem: It was Mr. Kim ____ taught us English last year.
questions.why: 사람 주어를 강조하는 강조구문으로 that(또는 who)을 쓴다. which·what은 불가.

questions.stem: It was a cat ____ made the noise last night.
questions.why: 동물(사물 취급)을 강조하므로 that이 알맞다. who는 사람에게만 쓴다.

questions.stem: I ____ like this song very much.
questions.why: 일반동사 like를 강조할 때 주어가 I이고 현재이므로 do를 쓴다. be동사는 일반동사 앞에 올 수 없다.

questions.stem: She ____ like math.
questions.why: 주어 She가 3인칭 단수이고 현재이므로 강조의 does를 쓴다. 뒤의 동사는 원형 like.

questions.stem: He ____ finish his homework yesterday.
questions.why: yesterday 과거의 일을 강조하므로 did + 동사원형(finish)을 쓴다.

questions.stem: They ____ enjoy the concert last night.
questions.why: last night 과거이므로 강조의 did를 쓴다. did 뒤에는 동사원형이 온다.

questions.stem: My brother ____ like soccer.
questions.why: My brother는 3인칭 단수이므로 does + 동사원형으로 강조한다. be동사는 일반동사 like 앞에 쓸 수 없다.

questions.stem: I really ____ want to help you now.
questions.why: now(지금)의 현재 마음을 강조하므로 do를 쓴다. did는 과거라서 now와 맞지 않는다.

questions.stem: We ____ hope you will come to the party.
questions.why: 주어 We + 현재이므로 강조의 do가 알맞다. does는 3인칭 단수 주어에 쓴다.

questions.stem: Emma ____ look happy today.
questions.why: Emma는 3인칭 단수이므로 does + 동사원형(look)으로 강조한다. is look처럼 be동사와 일반동사는 나란히 쓸 수 없다.

questions.stem: He did ____ the door before he left.
questions.why: 강조의 did 뒤에는 반드시 동사원형이 온다. 그래서 lock이 정답.

questions.stem: She does ____ up early every morning.
questions.why: does가 이미 3인칭 단수·현재를 나타내므로 뒤에는 동사원형 get을 쓴다.

questions.stem: I did ____ my best on the test.
questions.why: 강조의 did 뒤에는 동사원형 try가 온다. tried처럼 과거형을 겹쳐 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem: They do ____ their room every weekend.
questions.why: 강조의 do 뒤에는 동사원형이 오므로 clean이 알맞다.

questions.stem: Tom does ____ the piano well.
questions.why: does 뒤에는 동사원형이 온다. 3인칭 단수라고 plays를 또 쓰면 틀린다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: It was Sam that break the cup.
It were my shoes that I lost.
It was on Monday that we met.
questions.why: ③은 부사구 on Monday를 강조한 올바른 강조구문. ①은 broke, ②는 was, ④는 does like, ⑤는 did go가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: It was Jenny that called me.
It is this cap that I want.
questions.why: 강조의 did 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 하므로 did finish가 맞다. 나머지는 모두 올바른 강조 표현이다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 고르면?
choices: I did meet her last week.
It am I that made the mistake.
It was the dog that were barking.
questions.why: ②는 과거의 일을 did + 동사원형으로 바르게 강조했다. ①은 does get, ③은 It was, ④는 that was, ⑤는 does like가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 고르면?
choices: It was Julie that sang the song.
It was a pen that he lost.
questions.why: 주어 They는 복수이므로 do want가 되어야 한다. does는 3인칭 단수 주어에만 쓴다.

questions.stem:
A: Do you really like winter?
B: Yes, I ____ like winter.
questions.why: 현재의 사실(Do you ~?)에 대한 대답이므로 강조의 do가 알맞다. did는 과거.

questions.stem:
A: Did Mike really fix the bike?
B: Yes, he ____ fix it himself.
questions.why: 질문이 과거(Did ~?)이므로 강조의 did + 동사원형 fix로 답한다.

questions.stem:
A: Who broke the vase?
B: It ____ the cat that broke it.
questions.why: broke(과거)의 일을 강조하므로 It was ~ that. It 뒤에는 항상 단수 be동사 was를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
A: ____ it your brother that took the photo?
B: Yes, it was.
questions.why: 대답이 it was이고 took(과거)이므로 의문문도 Was it ~ that ~?이 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
정말이지 나는 그 영화를 좋아한다.
questions.why: 주어 I + 현재이므로 do + 동사원형 like로 강조한다. ②는 주어 불일치, ④는 동사원형이 아니라서 틀렸다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
그 창문을 깬 것은 바로 Peter였다.
choices: It is Peter that broke the window.
It was Peter that broke the window.
It was Peter what broke the window.
Peter was it that broke the window.
It were Peter that broke the window.
questions.why: 과거(깼다)이므로 It was ~ that 어순이 맞다. what은 강조구문에 못 쓰고, ④는 어순이 틀렸다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
그녀는 정말로 그 답을 안다.
questions.why: 3인칭 단수·현재이므로 does + 동사원형 know. does 뒤에 knows를 또 쓰면 안 된다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
내가 어제 잃어버린 것은 바로 내 우산이었다.
choices: It was my umbrella that I lost yesterday.
It is my umbrella that I lost yesterday.
It was my umbrella what I lost yesterday.
It my umbrella was that I lost yesterday.
It was my umbrella that I lost it yesterday.
questions.why: 과거의 일이므로 It was ~ that. ⑤처럼 강조한 목적어(it)를 that절에 다시 쓰면 안 된다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
그는 정말로 어제 숙제를 끝냈다.
choices: He did finish his homework yesterday.
He did finished his homework yesterday.
He does finish his homework yesterday.
He do finish his homework yesterday.
He was finish his homework yesterday.
questions.why: 과거(yesterday)이므로 did + 동사원형 finish로 강조한다. did finished처럼 과거형을 겹치면 틀린다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
공원에서 그를 만난 것은 바로 지수였다.
choices: It was Jisu that met him in the park.
It was Jisu whose met him in the park.
It is Jisu that meets him in the park.
It was Jisu that she met him in the park.
Jisu was it that met him in the park.
questions.why: 과거의 일이므로 It was Jisu that ~. ④처럼 that절에 주어 she를 다시 쓰면 안 된다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 알맞은 것은?
• It was Ben ____ ate my cookie.
• It was this movie ____ made me cry.
questions.why: 사람(Ben)에는 who, 사물(this movie)에는 which도 가능하지만, 둘 다에 공통으로 쓸 수 있는 것은 that뿐이다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 알맞은 것은?
• It ____ John that found my dog.
• It ____ last Sunday that we went camping.
questions.why: found·went 모두 과거이므로 두 문장 다 It was ~ that이 알맞다.

questions.stem: It was at the bus stop ____ I saw Mr. Lee.
questions.why: 장소 부사구 at the bus stop을 강조하는 강조구문이므로 that을 쓴다.

questions.stem: It was my mom ____ cooked this soup.
questions.why: 사람 주어 my mom을 강조하므로 that(또는 who)이 알맞다. which는 사물에만 쓴다.

questions.stem: It was last Friday ____ the concert was held.
questions.why: 시간 부사구 last Friday를 강조하는 강조구문이므로 that을 쓴다.

questions.stem: It was a letter ____ Anna sent to me.
questions.why: 사물 목적어 a letter를 강조하므로 that이 알맞다. what은 강조구문에 쓸 수 없다.

questions.stem: My grandma ____ tell great stories.
questions.why: My grandma는 3인칭 단수이므로 강조의 does + 동사원형 tell을 쓴다.

questions.stem: The students ____ study hard before the exam last week.
questions.why: last week 과거의 일을 강조하므로 did를 쓴다. 뒤의 study는 동사원형이다.

questions.stem: I did ____ you the truth at that time.
questions.why: 강조의 did 뒤에는 동사원형 tell이 온다. told를 쓰면 과거가 겹쳐 틀린다.

questions.stem: She does ____ her grandmother every weekend.
questions.why: does 뒤에는 동사원형이 오므로 visit이 정답. visits처럼 -s를 또 붙이지 않는다.

questions.stem: We did ____ the game, but we lost the next one.
questions.why: 강조의 did 뒤에는 동사원형 win을 쓴다. won은 과거형이라 did와 겹친다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 be동사를 알맞은 형태로 쓰시오.
It ____ Kevin that ate the last piece of pizza last night.
questions.why: last night 과거의 일을 강조하므로 It was ~ that을 쓴다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 알맞은 말을 한 단어로 쓰시오.
It was my cat ____ scratched the sofa.
questions.why: 강조구문의 빈칸에는 that을 쓴다. 동물이므로 which도 가능하지만 who는 안 된다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 강조하는 조동사를 현재형 한 단어로 쓰시오.
I really ____ like this color.
questions.why: 주어 I + 현재이므로 강조의 조동사 do를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 강조하는 조동사를 현재형 한 단어로 쓰시오.
She ____ love her puppy.
questions.why: 주어 She가 3인칭 단수이고 뒤에 동사원형 love가 있으므로 does가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 강조하는 조동사를 알맞은 형태로 쓰시오.
He ____ call me last night.
questions.why: last night 과거의 일을 강조하므로 did + 동사원형 call을 쓴다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안의 동사를 do를 이용한 강조 표현 두 단어로 바꿔 쓰시오.
He really (enjoys) computer games.
questions.why: 3인칭 단수 현재 enjoys는 does + 동사원형 enjoy로 강조한다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안의 동사를 do를 이용한 강조 표현 두 단어로 바꿔 쓰시오.
I (love) my new school.
questions.why: 주어 I + 현재이므로 do + 동사원형 love로 강조한다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안의 동사를 do를 이용한 강조 표현 두 단어로 바꿔 쓰시오.
She (finished) her project last night.
questions.why: 과거형 finished는 did + 동사원형 finish로 강조한다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안의 동사를 do를 이용한 강조 표현 두 단어로 바꿔 쓰시오.
They (watched) the drama yesterday.
questions.why: 과거형 watched는 did + 동사원형 watch로 강조한다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓰시오.
He did <u>cleaned</u> his room.
questions.why: 강조의 did 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 하므로 cleaned를 clean으로 고친다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 두 단어를 바르게 고쳐 쓰시오.
She <u>do like</u> Korean food.
questions.why: 주어 She가 3인칭 단수이므로 do를 does로 고쳐 does like로 쓴다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓰시오.
It <u>were</u> Tom and Jerry that made the mess.
questions.why: 강조구문의 It 뒤에는 강조하는 말이 복수여도 항상 단수 be동사 was/is를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓰시오.
It was my phone <u>what</u> I left on the bus.
questions.why: It ~ that 강조구문에는 what을 쓸 수 없다. that(사물이므로 which도 가능)으로 고친다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓰시오.
It <u>is</u> Amy that broke my cup yesterday.
questions.why: yesterday 과거의 일이므로 that절의 시제에 맞춰 It was로 고친다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓰시오.
He did <u>goes</u> to the dentist last Friday.
questions.why: 강조의 did 뒤에는 동사원형이 오므로 goes를 go로 고친다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 t로 시작하는 한 단어를 쓰시오.
It was on Jeju Island ____ we spent our vacation.
questions.why: 장소 부사구 on Jeju Island를 강조하는 It ~ that 강조구문이다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 알맞은 말을 한 단어로 쓰시오.
A: Did you really send the letter?
B: Yes, I ____ send it.
questions.why: 과거(Did ~?)의 일을 강조해 답하므로 did + 동사원형 send를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 알맞은 말을 한 단어로 쓰시오.
A: Does Jane really play the violin?
B: Yes, she ____ play it.
questions.why: 3인칭 단수 현재의 일을 강조하므로 does를 쓴다. 뒤의 play는 동사원형.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 t로 시작하는 한 단어를 쓰시오.
It was this song ____ made her famous.
questions.why: 사물 주어 this song을 강조하는 It ~ that 강조구문이다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 강조하는 조동사를 현재형 한 단어로 쓰시오.
I ____ hope you get well soon.
questions.why: 주어 I + 현재의 마음을 강조하므로 do를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장에서 <u>Jane</u>을 강조한 문장으로 알맞은 것은?
Jane met Tom at the station yesterday.
choices: It was Jane that met Tom at the station yesterday.
It was Tom that Jane met at the station yesterday.
It was at the station that Jane met Tom yesterday.
It was yesterday that Jane met Tom at the station.
Jane was it that met Tom at the station yesterday.
questions.why: 주어 Jane을 It was와 that 사이에 넣고 나머지를 that 뒤에 쓴다. ②는 목적어, ③은 장소, ④는 시간을 강조한 문장이다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장에서 <u>at the station</u>을 강조한 문장으로 알맞은 것은?
Jane met Tom at the station yesterday.
choices: It was Jane that met Tom at the station yesterday.
It was yesterday that Jane met Tom at the station.
It was at the station that Jane met Tom yesterday.
It was Tom that met Jane at the station yesterday.
It was at the station that Jane met Tom at yesterday.
questions.why: 부사구는 전치사까지 통째로 It was와 that 사이에 넣는다. ⑤는 at이 중복되어 틀렸다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장에서 <u>this morning</u>을 강조한 문장으로 알맞은 것은?
Minho found the key under the bed this morning.
choices: It was this morning that Minho found the key under the bed.
It was Minho that found the key under the bed this morning.
It was the key that Minho found under the bed this morning.
It was under the bed that Minho found the key this morning.
This morning was it that Minho found the key under the bed.
questions.why: 시간 부사구 this morning을 It was ~ that 사이에 넣는다. ⑤는 어순이 틀렸다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장에서 <u>the key</u>를 강조한 문장으로 알맞은 것은?
Minho found the key under the bed this morning.
choices: It was Minho that found the key under the bed this morning.
It was the key that Minho found under the bed this morning.
It was under the bed that Minho found the key this morning.
It was the key what Minho found under the bed this morning.
It was the key that Minho found it under the bed this morning.
questions.why: 목적어 the key를 강조 자리에 두고 that절에는 다시 쓰지 않는다. ⑤는 it이 중복, ④는 what이라서 틀렸다.

questions.stem: It was Susan ____ I lent my notebook to.
questions.why: 사람 목적어 Susan을 강조하는 강조구문으로 that을 쓴다. which는 사물, what은 강조구문에 불가.

questions.stem: ____ was in 2010 that the bridge was built.
questions.why: 강조구문은 반드시 It is/was ~ that의 형태로 시작한다.

questions.stem: It was the blue shirt ____ he chose for the party.
questions.why: 사물 목적어 the blue shirt를 강조하므로 that이 알맞다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 It의 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: It was Jack that broke the rule.
It was my aunt that gave me this doll.
It is certain that he will win.
It was this photo that reminded me of you.
It was in Busan that I first met her.
questions.why: ③은 가주어 It(진주어 that절)이고, 나머지는 모두 It ~ that 강조구문이다. ③은 It is ~ that을 빼면 문장이 안 되지만 나머지는 빼도 완전한 문장이 된다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 밑줄 친 <u>that</u>의 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: It was Leo <u>that</u> won the race.
It was a ring <u>that</u> she lost.
It is true <u>that</u> the earth is round.
It was on Friday <u>that</u> the test ended.
It was my dad <u>that</u> drove us home.
questions.why: ③의 that은 진주어 명사절을 이끄는 접속사이고, 나머지는 강조구문의 that이다.

questions.stem: Who ____ it that left the door open?
questions.why: 의문사를 강조하는 「의문사 + was it that ~?」 구문이다. it 앞이므로 단수 was를 쓴다.

questions.stem: What was it ____ you wanted to tell me?
questions.why: 의문사 What을 강조한 「What was it that ~?」 구문으로 빈칸에는 that이 온다.

questions.stem: ____ was it that called you last night?
questions.why: that절에 주어가 빠져 있으므로 전화를 건 '사람'을 묻는 Who가 알맞다. When·Why는 주어 역할을 할 수 없다.

questions.stem:
A: What is it ____ you're looking for?
B: My glasses.
questions.why: 의문사 What을 강조한 「What is it that ~?」 구문이므로 that을 쓴다.

questions.stem:
(A), (B), (C)의 괄호 안에서 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
(A) It (is / was) Ted that painted this picture last week.
(B) She (do / does) enjoy cooking.
(C) He did (pass / passed) the exam.
questions.why: (A) last week 과거이므로 was, (B) 3인칭 단수이므로 does, (C) did 뒤에는 동사원형 pass.

questions.stem:
(A), (B), (C)의 괄호 안에서 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
(A) It was my wallet (that / what) I was looking for.
(B) They (did / do) visit the museum yesterday.
(C) It was Ann (who / which) baked these cookies.
questions.why: (A) 강조구문에는 what 불가 → that, (B) yesterday 과거 → did, (C) 사람 Ann → who.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: It was Harry that solved the puzzle.
It was this cap that my uncle bought for me.
She does wants to join the club.
It was in the kitchen that I found the note.
questions.why: does 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 하므로 does want가 맞다. 나머지는 모두 올바르다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: It were the twins that hid my shoes.
What was it that made you angry?
It was yesterday what the package arrived.
questions.why: ③은 의문사 What을 강조한 올바른 구문. ①은 It was, ②는 does exercise, ④는 did clean, ⑤는 what이 아니라 that이어야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
그 소식을 나에게 말해 준 사람은 바로 수진이었다.
choices: It was Sujin that told me the news.
It was Sujin that she told me the news.
It was Sujin what told me the news.
Sujin it was who telling me the news.
It is Sujin that tells me the news.
questions.why: 과거의 일이므로 It was Sujin that ~. ②처럼 that절에 주어를 다시 쓰면 안 된다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
내가 지갑을 잃어버린 곳은 바로 지하철역이었다.
choices: It was at the subway station that I lost my wallet.
It was at the subway station what I lost my wallet.
It was at the subway station that I lost it my wallet.
It is at the subway station that I lose my wallet.
It was at the subway station which I lost my wallet.
questions.why: 장소 부사구를 전치사째 강조 자리에 넣고 that을 쓴다. ④는 시제, ⑤는 which라서 틀렸다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
그는 정말로 매운 음식을 잘 먹는다.
choices: He do eats spicy food well.
He does eat spicy food well.
He does eats spicy food well.
He is eat spicy food well.
He did ate spicy food well.
questions.why: 3인칭 단수 현재이므로 does + 동사원형 eat으로 강조한다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 알맞은 것은?
• It was Roy ____ fixed my computer.
• It was this novel ____ won the prize.
questions.why: 사람(Roy)과 사물(this novel) 모두를 강조할 수 있는 것은 that뿐이다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 알맞은 것은?
• He ____ apologize to me right after the fight yesterday.
• We ____ have a good time at the camp last week.
questions.why: 두 문장 모두 과거(yesterday, last week)의 일을 강조하므로 did + 동사원형을 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
① <u>It</u> was Clara ② <u>that</u> ③ <u>lend</u> me the book ④ <u>at</u> the library ⑤ <u>yesterday</u>.
questions.why: yesterday 과거의 일이므로 that절의 동사는 과거형 lent가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
It ① <u>was</u> last Sunday ② <u>what</u> we ③ <u>went</u> hiking ④ <u>with</u> our club members ⑤ <u>together</u>.
questions.why: It ~ that 강조구문에는 what을 쓸 수 없으므로 what을 that으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
① <u>It</u> was in this room ② <u>that</u> the famous writer ③ <u>wrote</u> his first novel ④ <u>in</u> 1990, and people still ⑤ <u>visits</u> it today.
questions.why: 주어 people은 복수이므로 visits가 아니라 visit이 되어야 한다. 강조구문 부분은 모두 올바르다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
Julia ① <u>does</u> ② <u>practices</u> the flute ③ <u>every</u> evening ④ <u>in</u> her room ⑤ <u>alone</u>.
questions.why: 강조의 does 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 하므로 practices를 practice로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: It was because of the heavy snow ____ the school was closed.
questions.why: 이유의 부사구 because of ~를 강조하는 강조구문이므로 that을 쓴다. why는 쓸 수 없다.

questions.stem: Where was it ____ you parked the car?
questions.why: 의문사 Where를 강조하는 「Where was it that ~?」 구문이다.

questions.stem:
A: You never eat vegetables.
B: That's not true. I ____ eat them every day.
questions.why: every day 현재의 습관을 강조해 반박하므로 do를 쓴다. did는 과거라서 맞지 않는다.

questions.stem:
A: Minsu says he didn't take your pen.
B: But I saw him! He ____ take it!
questions.why: 과거에 실제로 가져갔다는 사실을 강조하므로 did + 동사원형 take를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 <u>the mirror</u>를 강조한 문장으로 알맞은 것은?
He broke the mirror this morning.
choices: It was the mirror that he broke this morning.
It was he that broke the mirror this morning.
It was this morning that he broke the mirror.
It was the mirror what he broke this morning.
It was the mirror that he broke it this morning.
questions.why: 목적어 the mirror를 강조 자리에 두고 that절에서는 빼야 한다. ⑤는 it이 중복이다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 <u>Dr. Park</u>을 강조한 문장으로 알맞은 것은?
Dr. Park gave a speech at our school last Monday.
choices: It was at our school that Dr. Park gave a speech last Monday.
It was last Monday that Dr. Park gave a speech at our school.
It was Dr. Park that gave a speech at our school last Monday.
It was a speech that Dr. Park gave at our school last Monday.
It was Dr. Park that he gave a speech at our school last Monday.
questions.why: 주어 Dr. Park을 강조 자리에 넣는다. ⑤는 that절에 he를 다시 써서 틀렸다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 들어갈 말이 순서대로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
It ____ two years ago ____ my family moved to Seoul.
questions.why: two years ago 과거이므로 was, 강조구문이므로 that을 쓴다.

questions.stem: It was Nora ____ the teacher praised in class.
questions.why: 사람 목적어 Nora를 강조하는 강조구문이므로 that이 알맞다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장들 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: It was this song that she listened to last night.
It was this song that she listened last night.
It were this song that she listened to last night.
It was this song what she listened to last night.
It was this song that she listened to it last night.
questions.why: listen to의 전치사 to는 남겨 두어야 한다. ②는 to가 빠졌고 ⑤는 it이 중복이다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장들 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: I did lock the door when I left.
What was it that you ate for lunch?
It was my grandfather that planted this tree.
It was during the vacation that I read ten books.
questions.why: 강조의 did 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 하므로 did understand가 맞다.

questions.stem: He ____ say sorry, but I didn't hear it.
questions.why: didn't와 같은 과거 상황이므로 강조의 did + 동사원형 say를 쓴다.

questions.stem: It is my little brother ____ always makes me laugh.
questions.why: 사람 주어를 강조하므로 that(또는 who)을 쓴다. 현재의 습관이라 It is를 쓴 강조구문이다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 옮길 때 빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
내가 원하는 것은 바로 너의 정직한 대답이다.
→ It is your honest answer ____ I want.
questions.why: 목적어를 강조하는 It is ~ that 강조구문이므로 that을 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 알맞은 것은?
• Ken ____ finish the marathon last year.
• She ____ not come to the meeting yesterday.
questions.why: 첫 문장은 과거의 강조(did finish), 둘째 문장은 과거의 부정(did not come)으로 둘 다 did가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 대답에 대한 질문으로 가장 알맞은 것은?
B: It was my cousin that sent me the gift.
choices: Who was it that sent you the gift?
What was it that you sent to your cousin?
When was it that your cousin sent you the gift?
Where was it that you got the gift?
Why was it that you sent the gift?
questions.why: 대답이 보낸 '사람'(my cousin)을 강조하므로 사람을 묻는 Who was it that ~?이 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 It ~ that 강조구문으로 바꿀 때 강조할 수 없는 것은?
Amy bought a scarf for her mom at the market.
questions.why: 동사는 It ~ that 강조구문으로 강조할 수 없고 do/does/did로 강조한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장에서 It ~ that 강조구문으로 강조할 수 없는 것은?
Jake played soccer with his friends in the playground yesterday.
questions.why: 주어·목적어·부사구는 강조할 수 있지만 동사 played는 It ~ that으로 강조할 수 없다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: It was Mike ____ broke his arm.
It was a doll ____ she made for me.
It was in March ____ we first met.
It was the rain ____ ruined our picnic.
questions.why: ④는 동사 강조의 do가 들어가고, 나머지는 모두 강조구문의 that이 들어간다.

questions.stem:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 알맞은 것은?
A: Was it Tom that ate your sandwich?
B: No, it wasn't. ____
choices: It was Jerry that ate it.
It was a sandwich that Tom ate.
It was Tom that ate it.
Jerry was it that ate it.
questions.why: Tom이 아니라고 했으므로 다른 사람(Jerry)을 강조하는 ①이 자연스럽다. ③은 did ate가 틀렸고 ④는 대답과 모순된다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 강조하는 표현이 쓰이지 않은 문장은?
choices: It was Ben that broke the chair.
She does drink milk every morning.
He did his homework after dinner.
It was this key that opened the box.
questions.why: ④의 did는 '~을 했다'라는 뜻의 일반동사이고, 나머지는 강조의 do/does 또는 It ~ that 강조구문이다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 <u>Sora</u>를 강조하는 It ~ that 강조구문으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
Sora broke the cup.
questions.answer: It was Sora that broke the cup.
alt: It was Sora who broke the cup.
questions.why: 과거의 일이므로 It was Sora that ~으로 쓴다. 사람이므로 who도 가능하다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 <u>this letter</u>를 강조하는 It ~ that 강조구문으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
He wrote this letter.
questions.answer: It was this letter that he wrote.
alt: It was this letter which he wrote.
questions.why: 목적어 this letter를 It was와 that 사이에 넣고, that절에는 다시 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 <u>in the garden</u>을 강조하는 It ~ that 강조구문으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
She found the ring in the garden.
questions.answer: It was in the garden that she found the ring.
questions.why: 장소 부사구는 전치사 in까지 통째로 강조 자리에 넣는다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 <u>last night</u>을 강조하는 It ~ that 강조구문으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
The accident happened last night.
questions.answer: It was last night that the accident happened.
questions.why: 시간 부사구 last night을 It was와 that 사이에 넣는다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 <u>my dad</u>를 강조하는 It ~ that 강조구문으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
My dad washed the car yesterday.
questions.answer: It was my dad that washed the car yesterday.
alt: It was my dad who washed the car yesterday.
questions.why: 주어 my dad를 강조 자리에 넣고 나머지를 that 뒤에 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 동사를 강조하는 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
I like your smile.
questions.why: 현재·1인칭이므로 do + 동사원형으로 동사를 강조한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 동사를 강조하는 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
She keeps her promises.
questions.why: 3인칭 단수 현재이므로 does + 동사원형 keep으로 강조한다. keeps의 -s는 does에 흡수된다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 동사를 강조하는 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
He passed the test.
questions.why: 과거형 passed는 did + 동사원형 pass로 강조한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 동사를 강조하는 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
They enjoyed the trip.
questions.why: 과거의 일이므로 did + 동사원형 enjoy로 강조한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 동사를 강조하는 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
Mia knows the truth.
questions.why: 3인칭 단수 현재이므로 does + 동사원형 know로 강조한다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓰시오.
It was my key <u>what</u> I dropped on the street.
questions.why: 강조구문에는 what을 쓸 수 없고 that(사물이므로 which도 가능)을 쓴다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓰시오.
It <u>is</u> Ted that visited me last weekend.
questions.why: last weekend 과거의 일이므로 that절의 시제에 맞춰 was로 고친다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓰시오.
She does <u>speaks</u> French very well.
questions.why: 강조의 does 뒤에는 동사원형이 오므로 speaks를 speak로 고친다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓰시오.
He did <u>wrote</u> this poem in 2020.
questions.why: 강조의 did 뒤에는 동사원형이 오므로 wrote를 write로 고친다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓰시오.
It was Emma <u>which</u> answered the phone.
questions.why: 사람 Emma를 강조하므로 which가 아니라 that이나 who를 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
빈칸에 강조하는 조동사를 알맞은 형태로 쓰시오.
That question was hard, but I ____ solve it in the end.
questions.why: was가 있는 과거 이야기이므로 did + 동사원형 solve로 강조한다.

questions.stem:
우리말에 맞게 빈칸에 한 단어를 쓰시오.
그녀가 태어난 곳은 바로 부산이었다.
→ It was in Busan ____ she was born.
questions.why: 장소 부사구 in Busan을 강조하는 It ~ that 강조구문이다.

questions.stem:
우리말에 맞게 빈칸에 한 단어를 쓰시오.
그들은 정말로 그 경기에서 이겼다.
→ They ____ win the game.
questions.why: '이겼다'는 과거이므로 did + 동사원형 win으로 강조한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 밑줄 친 부분을 묻는 강조 의문문으로 완성할 때 빈칸에 한 단어를 쓰시오.
You met <u>someone</u> at the mall.
→ Who was it ____ you met at the mall?
questions.why: 의문사 Who를 강조하는 「Who was it that ~?」 구문이다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 <u>the window</u>를 강조하는 It ~ that 강조구문으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
Tom fixed the window this morning.
questions.answer: It was the window that Tom fixed this morning.
alt: It was the window which Tom fixed this morning.
questions.why: 목적어 the window를 강조 자리에 넣고 that절에서는 뺀다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
ㄱ. It was the documentary that changed my mind about recycling.
ㄴ. It was because he was honest that everyone trusted him.
ㄷ. She does taking notes during every class.
ㄹ. What was it that surprised you most at the festival?
questions.why: ㄷ은 does 뒤에 동사원형 take가 와야 하므로 틀렸다. 이유 부사절(because ~)도 강조구문으로 강조할 수 있다(ㄴ).

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장을 모두 고른 것은?
ㄱ. It were the students that cleaned the beach last Saturday.
ㄴ. I did finish the report before the deadline.
ㄷ. It was in this cafe that the novelist wrote her first book.
ㄹ. He does knows how to solve this kind of problem.
questions.why: ㄱ은 It 뒤에 항상 단수 was를 써야 하고, ㄹ은 does 뒤에 동사원형 know가 와야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
• It was the coach that encouraged me to try again.
• It was yesterday what I heard the news.
• She did remembered to bring the tickets.
• It was at the airport that we said goodbye.
• I do understand why you were upset.
questions.why: 둘째 문장은 what → that, 셋째 문장은 did remember가 되어야 한다. 나머지 세 문장이 옳다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장의 개수는?
• It was this app that helped me study English.
• He do wants to be an astronaut.
• It was on the fifth floor that the fire started.
• Who was it that recommended this restaurant to you?
• It was the twins that was hiding behind the curtain.
questions.why: He do wants는 does want로, that was hiding은 강조된 the twins(복수)에 맞춰 that were hiding으로 고쳐야 한다. 틀린 문장은 2개.

questions.stem: 다음 중 It ~ that 강조구문이 아닌 것은?
choices: It was the noise that woke the baby.
It was obvious that she was lying.
It was my uncle that lent us the tent.
It was last winter that we visited Prague.
It was this picture that made her famous.
questions.why: ②는 가주어 It - 진주어 that절 구문이다. It was ~ that을 지웠을 때 완전한 문장이 남으면 강조구문인데, ②는 obvious만 남아 문장이 되지 않는다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 밑줄 친 <u>It</u>의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> It was courage that he needed most.
choices: <u>It</u> is important that you keep your word.
<u>It</u> was raining when I left home.
<u>It</u> was the smell of bread that filled the street.
<u>It</u> is ten kilometers from here to the lake.
<u>It</u> is said that the castle is haunted.
questions.why: <보기>는 강조구문의 It이다. ①⑤는 가주어, ②④는 날씨·거리를 나타내는 비인칭 주어이고, ③만 강조구문이다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 강조구문으로 바꾼 것 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
Lisa lost her passport at the hotel in Rome last summer.
choices: It was Lisa that lost her passport at the hotel in Rome last summer.
It was her passport that Lisa lost at the hotel in Rome last summer.
It was at the hotel in Rome that Lisa lost her passport last summer.
It was last summer that Lisa lost her passport at the hotel in Rome.
It was lost that Lisa her passport at the hotel in Rome last summer.
questions.why: 동사(lost)는 It ~ that 강조구문으로 강조할 수 없다. 주어·목적어·부사구를 강조한 ①~④는 모두 옳다.

questions.stem:
(A), (B), (C)의 괄호 안에서 알맞은 것끼리 짝지은 것은?
(A) It was not the price but the design (that / what) attracted customers.
(B) He (did / does) win the debate contest last month.
(C) It (was / is) during the war that this song was written.
questions.why: (A) 강조구문이므로 that, (B) last month 과거이므로 did, (C) was written 과거이므로 was.

questions.stem:
다음 질문의 <u>What</u>을 강조한 의문문으로 알맞은 것은?
What did you order at the cafe?
choices: What was it that you ordered at the cafe?
What it was that you ordered at the cafe?
What was it that did you order at the cafe?
What was it what you ordered at the cafe?
It was what that you ordered at the cafe?
questions.why: 의문사 강조는 「의문사 + was it that + 주어 + 동사」 어순이다. that절 안은 의문문 어순(did you order)이 아니라 평서문 어순을 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 질문의 <u>Where</u>를 강조한 의문문으로 알맞은 것은?
Where did she buy the hat?
choices: Where was it that did she buy the hat?
Where was it that she bought the hat?
Where it was that she bought the hat?
Where was it what she bought the hat?
It was where that she bought the hat?
questions.why: 「Where was it that + 평서문 어순」이 맞다. that절 안에서는 did she buy가 아니라 she bought로 쓴다.

questions.stem: When was it ____ you first rode a bike?
questions.why: 의문사 When을 강조하는 「When was it that ~?」 구문이므로 that을 쓴다.

questions.stem:
두 문장의 의미가 같도록 할 때 빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
He didn't know the truth until this morning.
= It was ____ this morning that he knew the truth.
questions.why: not ~ until을 강조구문으로 바꾸면 「It was not until A that B」(A가 되어서야 비로소 B했다)가 된다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수를 고르면?
• It was the little girl that were crying in the lobby.
• I did believed him at first.
• It was on Christmas Eve that the package finally arrived.
• Was it you that ate my pudding?
• She does make the best pasta in town.
questions.why: 첫 문장은 단수 the little girl에 맞춰 that was, 둘째는 did believe가 되어야 한다. 나머지 3개가 옳다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
It ① <u>was</u> in 2018 ② <u>that</u> my family ③ <u>travels</u> to Spain ④ <u>for</u> the first time ⑤ <u>together</u>.
questions.why: in 2018 과거의 일이므로 that절의 동사는 traveled가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
It was the students ① <u>who</u> ② <u>was</u> waiting ③ <u>in front of</u> the gym ④ <u>to thank</u> their coach ⑤ <u>yesterday</u>.
questions.why: 강조구문에서 that/who절의 동사는 강조된 말(the students, 복수)에 일치시키므로 were가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
그 회의에서 그 문제를 처음 제기한 사람은 바로 김 선생님이었다.
choices: It was Mr. Kim that first raised the problem at the meeting.
It was Mr. Kim what first raised the problem at the meeting.
It was Mr. Kim that the problem first raised at the meeting.
Mr. Kim was it that first raised the problem at the meeting.
It was at the meeting that Mr. Kim was first raised the problem.
questions.why: 주어 Mr. Kim을 강조하는 It was ~ that 구문. ③은 the problem이 주어가 되어 의미가 뒤집히고 ⑤는 수동태가 잘못 쓰였다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
나는 그때 정말로 최선을 다했다.
choices: I do my best at that time.
I did do my best at that time.
I did my best do at that time.
I do did my best at that time.
I did does my best at that time.
questions.why: 일반동사 do(하다)를 강조하려면 강조의 did 뒤에 동사원형 do를 써서 did do가 된다.

questions.stem:
빈칸 (A), (B)에 알맞은 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
It (A)____ my two cousins that (B)____ planning the surprise party for Grandma.
questions.why: It 뒤에는 강조하는 말이 복수여도 항상 단수 was를 쓰고, that절의 동사는 강조된 복수 명사에 맞춰 were를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
Everyone thought Jamie was lazy last year, but they were wrong. He ____ study every night back then; he just never showed off.
questions.why: last year·back then 과거의 사실을 강조하므로 did + 동사원형 study를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
Last week our class held a bake sale. Many students helped, but it was Nari ____ stayed until midnight to prepare everything.
questions.why: 사람 주어 Nari를 강조하는 강조구문이므로 that(또는 who)을 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 고르면?
choices: It was they that was late for the rehearsal.
Did it be Sam that called?
Was it at this bakery that you bought the bread?
It was skip breakfast that made me dizzy.
She did drank all the juice.
questions.why: 강조구문의 의문문은 Was it ~ that ~?으로 만든다. ①은 that were, ④는 동사(구) 강조 불가, ⑤는 did drink가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 것을 고르면?
choices: It was the typhoon that canceled our field trip.
It was my aunt that I stayed with during the holidays.
It was to win the contest that she practiced so hard.
It was from my grandfather that I learned chess.
It was Jenny that were chosen as class president.
questions.why: 강조된 Jenny는 단수이므로 that was chosen이 되어야 한다. ②③④처럼 전치사구·to부정사(목적)도 강조할 수 있다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 It ~ that 강조구문으로 바꿀 때 강조할 수 없는 것을 모두 고른 것은?
Somin quietly closed the door of the lab at noon.
ㄱ. Somin ㄴ. quietly ㄷ. closed ㄹ. the door of the lab ㅁ. at noon
questions.why: 동사(closed)와 양태 부사(quietly)는 It ~ that 강조구문으로 강조할 수 없다. 동사는 do 조동사로 강조한다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 do/does/did 중 '강조'의 뜻으로 쓰인 것의 개수는?
• I <u>did</u> my homework right after school.
• She <u>does</u> care about you.
• <u>Do</u> you like horror movies?
• He <u>did</u> apologize, but she was still angry.
• We <u>do</u> the dishes together every evening.
questions.why: 둘째(does care)와 넷째(did apologize)만 동사원형 앞에서 강조로 쓰였다. 첫째·다섯째는 일반동사, 셋째는 의문문을 만드는 조동사이다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 밑줄 친 <u>did</u>의 쓰임이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
choices: He <u>did</u> promise to call me back.
I <u>did</u> warn you about the traffic.
Tom <u>did</u> lock the gate last night.
questions.why: ③의 did는 '~을 했다'라는 일반동사이고, 나머지는 모두 동사원형 앞에 쓰인 강조의 did이다.

questions.stem:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
A: I can't believe you finished the 10 km race!
B: I told you! I ____ finish it, and I even got a medal.
questions.why: 이미 끝난 과거의 일(finished, got)을 강조하므로 did + 동사원형 finish를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
글의 흐름상 빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
People say honesty doesn't pay, but honesty ____ pay in the long run.
questions.why: 주어 honesty는 3인칭 단수이고 일반적 사실(현재)을 강조하므로 does를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 할 때 빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
Junho really admires the singer.
= Junho ____ the singer.
questions.why: really admires의 강조는 does + 동사원형 admire로 나타낸다.

questions.stem: It was the students, not the teacher, ____ proposed the new rule.
questions.why: 사람을 강조하는 강조구문이므로 that을 쓴다. 삽입구(not the teacher)가 있어도 구조는 같다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장에 대한 설명으로 옳은 것은?
It was the small bookstore that Mr. Han opened in 1995.
questions.why: It was ~ that을 지우면 Mr. Han opened the small bookstore in 1995.라는 완전한 문장이 되므로 목적어를 강조한 강조구문이다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 do를 이용해 강조한 것으로 알맞은 것은?
Sena waters the plants every morning.
choices: Sena do waters the plants every morning.
Sena does water the plants every morning.
Sena does waters the plants every morning.
Sena did water the plants every morning.
Sena is water the plants every morning.
questions.why: every morning 현재의 습관이므로 does + 동사원형 water로 강조한다. ④는 시제가 과거로 바뀌어 틀렸다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
• Was it in this park that the movie was filmed?
• It was this recipe that my mom taught me.
• He did move to Busan two years ago.
• It was the kids that were singing in the yard.
• She does gets nervous before every test.
questions.why: 마지막 문장만 does 뒤에 동사원형 get이 와야 해서 틀렸고, 나머지 4개는 모두 옳다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 빈칸에 들어갈 수 없는 것은?
It was ____ that made the whole class laugh.
questions.why: 강조 자리에는 주어 역할을 하는 명사(구)가 와야 한다. 부사 happily는 that절의 주어가 될 수 없다.

questions.stem:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 순서대로 짝지어진 것은?
A: ____ was it that you visited in London?
B: It was the British Museum ____ I visited.
questions.why: visited의 목적어(장소 이름)를 물으므로 What, 대답은 강조구문이므로 that. Where는 뒤에 목적어 없는 문장이 와야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
Our team lost badly in the first half. However, it ① <u>was</u> our captain ② <u>that</u> never ③ <u>gave</u> up and ④ <u>does</u> encourage us ⑤ <u>until</u> the end.
questions.why: 과거 이야기이므로 gave와 시제를 맞춰 강조의 did encourage가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem:
어법상 옳은 문장끼리 짝지은 것은?
ㄱ. It did rain a lot last night, so the river rose.
ㄴ. It was rain a lot last night.
ㄷ. Was it yesterday that Mina handed in the essay?
ㄹ. It was yesterday that did Mina hand in the essay.
questions.why: ㄱ은 동사 rain을 did로 강조한 문장, ㄷ은 강조구문의 의문문이다. ㄹ은 that절에 의문문 어순을 써서 틀렸다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?
그가 그 상자를 발견한 곳은 바로 그의 침대 밑이었다.
choices: It was under his bed that he found the box.
It was under his bed which he found the box.
It was under his bed that he found it the box.
Under his bed was it that he found the box.
It were under his bed that he found the box.
questions.why: 장소 부사구 under his bed를 강조하는 It was ~ that 구문이다. ③은 목적어가 중복되었다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장의 밑줄 친 부분을 강조한 것으로 알맞은 것은?
My mom hid the cookies <u>in the top drawer</u>.
choices: It was in the top drawer that my mom hid the cookies.
It was the top drawer that my mom hid the cookies.
It was my mom that hid the cookies in the top drawer.
It was the cookies that my mom hid in the top drawer.
It was in the top drawer what my mom hid the cookies.
questions.why: 부사구는 전치사 in까지 통째로 강조한다. ②는 in이 빠져 that절이 불완전하다.

questions.stem:
빈칸 (A), (B)에 알맞은 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
Ted says he (A)____ send the invitation two days ago, but it (B)____ yesterday that it actually arrived.
questions.why: (A) two days ago 과거의 강조이므로 did, (B) yesterday를 강조하는 과거 강조구문이므로 was.

questions.stem: 다음 중 나머지 넷과 문장 구조가 다른 것은?
choices: It was the drummer that started the show.
It was this bridge that appeared in the drama.
It was true that the rumor spread quickly.
It was Coach Lee that trained the national team.
It was last spring that we planted these tomatoes.
questions.why: ③은 가주어-진주어 구문이고 나머지는 강조구문이다. ③만 It was ~ that을 지우면 완전한 문장이 남지 않는다.

questions.stem:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
A: Was it you ____ turned off the music?
B: Yes, it was me.
questions.why: 사람(you)을 강조하는 강조구문이므로 that을 쓴다.

questions.stem: 어법상 틀린 부분을 포함한 문장은?
choices: I do hope the weather stays clear for the picnic.
It was the ending that disappointed most readers.
What was it that kept you up all night?
It was my sister that borrow my camera without asking.
He did return the books before the due date.
questions.why: 과거 강조구문(It was)이므로 that절의 동사는 과거형 borrowed가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 잘못 이해한 학생은?
It was Hana that gave the stray cat food on the porch last week.
choices: 서준: that 대신 who를 쓸 수 있어.
유나: 강조 표현을 빼면 Hana gave the stray cat food on the porch last week.가 돼.
하린: 과거의 일이므로 It was를 썼어.
questions.why: 강조구문의 It은 해석하지 않는 형식상의 주어이지 '그것'을 가리키는 대명사가 아니다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 수 있는 것은?
• It was Susie ____ everyone wanted to interview.
• It was the puppy ____ dug the hole in the yard.
questions.why: 첫 문장은 사람 목적어, 둘째 문장은 동물 주어의 강조라 공통으로 쓸 수 있는 것은 that뿐이다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장에서 어법상 틀린 부분을 바르게 고친 것은?
It was these gloves what Grandma knitted for me last winter.
questions.why: 강조구문에는 what을 쓸 수 없으므로 that(또는 which)으로 고친다. It은 항상 단수라 was가 맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 조건에 맞게 영작한 것으로 옳은 것은?
[조건] It ~ that 강조구문을 사용할 것.
내 마음을 바꾼 것은 바로 그 한 문장이었다.
choices: It was that one sentence that changed my mind.
That one sentence was it that changed my mind.
It was that one sentence what changed my mind.
It is that one sentence that changed my mind.
It was that one sentence that it changed my mind.
questions.why: 과거의 일이므로 It was ~ that. ④는 시제가 틀렸고 ⑤는 주어 it이 중복되었다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 <u>Miso</u>를 강조하는 It ~ that 강조구문으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
Miso planted these sunflowers along the fence last spring.
questions.answer: It was Miso that planted these sunflowers along the fence last spring.
alt: It was Miso who planted these sunflowers along the fence last spring.
questions.why: 과거의 일이므로 It was Miso that ~으로 쓰고 나머지 어순은 그대로 둔다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 <u>this scarf</u>를 강조하는 It ~ that 강조구문으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
My aunt knitted this scarf for me.
questions.answer: It was this scarf that my aunt knitted for me.
alt: It was this scarf which my aunt knitted for me.
questions.why: 목적어 this scarf를 강조 자리에 넣고 that절에서는 다시 쓰지 않는다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 <u>at the gym</u>을 강조하는 It ~ that 강조구문으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
Dad exercises at the gym every morning.
questions.answer: It is at the gym that Dad exercises every morning.
questions.why: 현재의 습관(exercises)이므로 It was가 아니라 It is를 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 <u>last October</u>를 강조하는 It ~ that 강조구문으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
The old bridge was rebuilt last October.
questions.answer: It was last October that the old bridge was rebuilt.
questions.why: 시간 부사구 last October를 It was와 that 사이에 넣고, 수동태 부분은 그대로 둔다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 동사를 강조하는 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
Ryan remembered my birthday.
questions.why: 과거형 remembered는 did + 동사원형 remember로 강조한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 동사를 강조하는 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
The twins clean their room on Saturdays.
questions.answer: The twins do clean their room on Saturdays.
questions.why: 복수 주어 + 현재이므로 do + 동사원형으로 강조한다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 동사를 강조하는 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
Ms. Choi teaches us music.
questions.answer: Ms. Choi does teach us music.
questions.why: 3인칭 단수 현재이므로 does + 동사원형 teach로 강조한다.

questions.stem:
다음 질문을 It ~ that을 이용해 의문사를 강조하는 의문문으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
Who broke the copy machine?
questions.answer: Who was it that broke the copy machine?
questions.why: 의문사 강조는 「Who + was it that + 나머지」 어순이며, broke가 과거이므로 was를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 질문을 It ~ that을 이용해 의문사를 강조하는 의문문으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
Where did you find my glasses?
questions.answer: Where was it that you found my glasses?
questions.why: 「Where was it that + 평서문 어순」으로 쓰며, that절에서는 did you find가 아니라 you found로 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 질문을 It ~ that을 이용해 의문사를 강조하는 의문문으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
What do you want for dinner?
questions.answer: What is it that you want for dinner?
questions.why: 현재시제이므로 「What is it that ~?」으로 쓰고, that절은 평서문 어순 you want로 쓴다.

questions.stem:
어법상 틀린 부분을 찾아 문장 전체를 바르게 다시 쓰시오.
It was the neighbors that was making noise all night.
questions.answer: It was the neighbors that were making noise all night.
alt: It was the neighbors who were making noise all night.
questions.why: that절의 동사는 강조된 복수 명사 the neighbors에 맞춰 were로 고친다.

questions.stem:
어법상 틀린 부분을 찾아 문장 전체를 바르게 다시 쓰시오.
It is my grandfather that built this house in 1980.
questions.answer: It was my grandfather that built this house in 1980.
alt: It was my grandfather who built this house in 1980.
questions.why: in 1980 과거의 일이므로 It is를 It was로 고친다.

questions.stem:
어법상 틀린 부분을 찾아 문장 전체를 바르게 다시 쓰시오.
She did forgot to bring her umbrella, so she got wet.
questions.answer: She did forget to bring her umbrella, so she got wet.
questions.why: 강조의 did 뒤에는 동사원형이 와야 하므로 forgot을 forget으로 고친다.

questions.stem:
우리말에 맞게 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 두 단어로 쓰시오.
민지는 정말로 그 뮤지컬 표를 샀다.
→ Minji ____ ____ the musical ticket.
questions.why: '샀다'는 과거이므로 did + 동사원형 buy로 강조한다.

questions.stem:
우리말에 맞게 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 세 단어로 쓰시오.
우리 팀을 승리로 이끈 것은 바로 팀워크였다.
→ ____ ____ ____ that led our team to victory.
questions.why: 과거의 일을 강조하는 It was ~ that 구문으로 It was teamwork를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 두 단어로 쓰시오.
He didn't realize his talent until he entered middle school.
= It was ____ ____ he entered middle school that he realized his talent.
questions.why: not ~ until 문장은 「It was not until A that B」 강조구문으로 바꿔 쓸 수 있다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장에서 밑줄 친 동사를 강조하는 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
I <u>locked</u> the front door before the trip.
questions.answer: I did lock the front door before the trip.
questions.why: 과거형 locked는 did + 동사원형 lock으로 강조한다.

questions.stem:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 한 단어로 쓰시오.
A: Was it Jinho that drew this poster?
B: No. It was Sumin ____ drew it, not Jinho.
questions.why: 사람 Sumin을 강조하는 강조구문이므로 that(또는 who)을 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 문장을 <u>because of the fog</u>를 강조하는 It ~ that 강조구문으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
The flight was delayed because of the fog.
questions.answer: It was because of the fog that the flight was delayed.
questions.why: 이유의 부사구 because of the fog를 통째로 It was와 that 사이에 넣는다.

questions.stem:
조건에 맞게 우리말을 영작하시오.
[조건] do의 알맞은 형태를 포함하여 5단어로 쓸 것.
그녀는 정말로 진실을 말한다.
questions.why: 3인칭 단수 현재이므로 does + 동사원형 tell을 써서 5단어 문장으로 만든다.
